title: 第21章 洛冰儿诱拐姬云生第22章 洛冰儿诱拐姬云生2
content_zh:
姬云生点点头，洛冰儿见状直接抱着他穿梭虚空，几息过后，姬云生顿时一阵呕吐感上来，连忙从她身上跳了下来，去到一旁直接呕吐起来，心里喃喃道：“卧槽了，下次你能先提前说下吗？虽然手段很牛逼，直接穿梭虚空，但我这才什么修为啊。
我才一个半岁的孩童，又是第一次穿梭虚空，你这是想要我直接呕吐至死？”洛冰儿见状，带着歉意温柔问道：“小弟弟，没事吧！”姬云生心里喃喃道：“我这难道不是有事？你看我都吐成什么样了？本来就肚子饿，还被你这么折腾，你是上天派来玩死我的吧！
还好我现在只是半岁孩童，不然的话，那可就丢脸丢大发了，那么多人看着。”洛冰儿见姬云生不理自己，又带着歉意温柔说道：“弟弟，这次就原谅姐姐吧，姐姐带你去吃大餐。”然后对着看戏的周围修士，释放自己的一丝修为，带着生气的语气说道：“
看什么看，都给我滚，在看本小姐直接杀了你们。”周围人一听，顿时纷纷逃跑，那狼狈样子受到惊吓的兔子一般，恨不得自己多双腿逃跑，就她释放的一丝修为，他们都感觉要死一样。短短一息之间，周围也没有人，继续看起姬云生的呕吐模样了。
这时，一个中年男性缓缓睁开双眼，自言自语说道：“我的天，这里怎么会出现如此强者，难道是皇朝来人？”然后对着房间外说道：“来人，给朕去查看下，刚才气息是何人所释放，查到之后，不要打搅对方，对方是元婴之上的强者。”
门卫侍卫一听恭敬回答道：“是，陛下放心，属下这就去查看，定不会惹怒对方。”李天元疑惑说道：“这到底是怎么回事？我元阳王朝怎么会来如此强者？就这时间来算，还没有到上供时间的啊！希望对方没有恶意，不然的话，我元阳王朝就要毁了。”
然后又继续闭上双眼修炼起来了，十多分钟后，姬云生顿时呕吐感消失了，但身体感觉都虚了。洛冰儿见状，连忙过来帮他清理一番后，又抱起他缓缓输送灵力，缓解他的不适之感。姬云生感受着力量的输送，他的脸色也逐渐好了起来，
洛冰儿见状才放下心来，温柔问道：“弟弟，没事了吧？”姬云生嗯了一声后，洛冰儿这才缓缓抱着他，进入一栋华丽的酒楼之中，刘二楞见状连忙过来迎接，笑着问道：“寒冰长老，您请，您请，还是老样子吗？”洛冰儿回答道：“刘掌柜，吃饭的包厢照旧，
饭菜的话，把你们的菜都上一遍吧。”然后取出一块上品灵石扔给他，又问道：“刘掌柜，这够不够？”刘二愣连忙接住灵石收了起来，笑着回答道：“够够够，我这就给寒冰长老找钱。”洛冰儿说道：“不用了，再给我上俩壶百花酿，多的就当不用找了，
今天心情好，难得带着弟弟来吃饭菜，刘掌柜麻烦菜上快点就好。”刘二愣一听顿时喜笑颜开，连忙笑着回答道：“多谢寒冰长老了，我这就去准备安排，您带着您弟弟，先上去包厢等候，饭菜很快就上来。”连忙去安排厨子，赶紧先做洛冰儿要求的饭菜了。
洛冰儿也是抱着姬云生，往楼上贵宾包厢走去，坐好后温柔问道：“弟弟，你看姐姐对你好吧，这里的消费可是不便宜的。要是换做下品灵石的话，我们这顿饭菜可是相当于花了一百万。”姬云生见状本想下意识，拿纸笔写字回答，但他发现自己好像来的时候，
都没有来得及拿上，纸笔就直接被带着来了。洛冰儿见状温柔问道：“弟弟，你在找什么？”姬云生一听，开始在空中写起字来，也不知道洛冰儿能看懂，还是看不懂。洛冰儿见状疑惑了，好像突然想到了什么，温柔问道：“弟弟，你是在找纸笔吗？”
姬云生点点头，洛冰儿见状从空间戒指中，取出一张精致类似纸的物品，和一支精美的毛笔递给他，温柔说道：“弟弟，你用这个写吧，这两件东西都是极品灵器，就当姐姐送你的小玩意了。”然后又拿出一个空间戒指，带在他的小手指上，
又温柔说道：“这空间戒指弟弟收好了，有时间的话，滴血认主下，这样安全些。至于里面的资源，等回去后，姐姐教你药理知识后，你拿着修炼就好。用完在和我说，我到时候再给你，日后的修炼资源。”姬云生一听点点头，心里喃喃道：“看来这便宜姐姐还不错，
这才两次见面，就给我这些东西，不过这空间戒指倒是很神奇，居然能自行适应我手指的尺寸，带着丝毫没有勒着的感觉。”
content_en:
Ji Yunsheng nodded. Seeing this, Luo Bing'er hugged him and shuttled through the void. After a few breaths, Ji Yunsheng suddenly felt a sense of vomiting. He quickly jumped off her body and went to the side to vomit directly. He murmured in his heart: "Damn it, can you tell me this in advance next time? Although my method is very awesome, I can directly shuttle through the void, but what kind of cultivation level do I have?
I am only a half-year-old child, and this is my first time traveling through the void. Do you want me to vomit directly to death? Seeing this, Luo Bing'er asked gently and apologetically: "Little brother, are you okay?" "Ji Yunsheng murmured in his heart: "Isn't something wrong with me? Do you see how I vomited? I’m already hungry, but you’re still tormenting me like this. You must have been sent by God to kill me!
Fortunately, I am only a half-year-old child now, otherwise, it would be very embarrassing with so many people watching. Seeing that Ji Yunsheng ignored her, Luo Bing'er said softly and apologetically: "Brother, please forgive my sister this time. My sister will take you to a big dinner." "Then he released a trace of his cultivation to the monks watching the show and said in an angry tone:"
Whatever you are looking at, get out of here. I will kill you right away while you are watching. "When the people around her heard this, they immediately ran away. They looked like frightened rabbits, wishing they could use more legs to escape. They all felt as if they were going to die with the slightest bit of cultivation she released. In just a short breath, there was no one around, and he continued to watch Ji Yunsheng vomiting.
At this time, a middle-aged man slowly opened his eyes and said to himself: "My God, how could such a powerful person appear here? Could it be someone from the imperial dynasty?" Then he said to the outside of the room: "Come here, let me check who released the breath just now. After you find out, don't disturb the other person. The other person is a strong person above Nascent Soul."
Upon hearing this, the guard respectfully replied: "Yes, your majesty, don't worry, I will go check it out now, and I will not offend the other party." Li Tianyuan said doubtfully: "What is going on? How could such a powerful person come to our Yuanyang Dynasty? As far as this time is concerned, it is not the time to pay tribute! I hope the other party has no ill intentions, otherwise, our Yuanyang Dynasty will be destroyed."
Then he continued to practice with his eyes closed. After more than ten minutes, Ji Yunsheng's vomiting suddenly disappeared, but his body felt weak. Seeing this, Luo Bing'er hurriedly came over to help him clean up, then picked him up and slowly transferred spiritual energy to relieve his discomfort. Ji Yunsheng felt the transfer of power, and his complexion gradually improved.
Luo Bing'er felt relieved when she saw this, and asked gently: "Brother, are you okay?" After Ji Yunsheng said yes, Luo Bing'er slowly hugged him and entered a gorgeous restaurant. Upon seeing this, Liu Erling hurriedly came over to greet him and asked with a smile: "Elder Hanbing, please, please, is it still the same?" Luo Bing'er replied: "Shopkeeper Liu, the dining box is still the same.
As for food, serve all your dishes. Then he took out a high-grade spiritual stone and threw it to him, and asked: "Shopkeeper Liu, is this enough?" " Liu Er was stunned and quickly caught the spirit stone and put it away. He smiled and replied: "Enough, enough, enough. I will give Elder Han Bing change right now. Luo Bing'er said: "No need, give me two more pots of Baihua Brewing. If there are more, I won't need to look for them."
I'm in a good mood today. It's rare to bring my brother here for a meal. Shopkeeper Liu can please serve the food quickly. Liu Er was stunned and immediately beamed with joy, and quickly replied with a smile: "Thank you, Elder Han Bing. I will go and make arrangements. You take your brother and go up to the private room to wait. The food will be served soon." "Hurry to arrange a cook and quickly prepare the meal Luo Bing'er requested.
Luo Bing'er also carried Ji Yunsheng and walked to the VIP box upstairs. After sitting down, she asked gently: "Brother, look at how good my sister is to you. The consumption here is not cheap. If it were for low-grade spiritual stones, our meal would be equivalent to spending a whole fortune.million. "When Ji Yunsheng saw this, he wanted to subconsciously take a pen and paper to write an answer, but he found that when he came,
I didn't even have time to pick it up, and the paper and pen were brought directly. Seeing this, Luo Bing'er asked gently: "Brother, what are you looking for? "When Ji Yunsheng heard this, he began to write in the air. He didn't know if Luo Bing'er could understand it or not. Luo Bing'er was confused when he saw this, as if something suddenly occurred to him, and asked gently: "Brother, are you looking for paper and pen? "
Ji Yunsheng nodded. Upon seeing this, Luo Bing'er took out a piece of delicate paper-like object from the space ring, and handed it to him with a delicate brush. She said softly: "Brother, you can write with this. These two things are top-quality spiritual weapons. Just treat them as gadgets given to you by my sister. "Then he took out a space ring and put it on his little finger.
Then he said softly: "Brother, I have put this space ring away. If I have time, I will shed blood to identify the owner. It is safer this way. As for the resources inside, after you go back and your sister teaches you the pharmacological knowledge, you can just take them and practice. When you finish, tell me that I will give you the resources for future cultivation when the time comes. "Ji Yunsheng nodded and murmured in his heart: "It seems that this cheap sister is not bad.
They only gave me these things after two meetings, but this space ring is really magical. It can actually adapt to the size of my finger without any feeling of being strangled. "
